ctu1.sentence: For Small Enterprises, the investment limit is set at INR 5 crore.

ctu2.sentence: Medium Enterprises can have an investment of up to INR 10 crore.

ctu1.sentence: The scheme is implemented by the Department of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and Textiles, Government of West Bengal.

ctu2.sentence: As of 2023, MSMEs contribute approximately 30 percent to the state’s GDP.
